#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

const int MODULO = 1000000007;

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    int m = 2 * n;
    std::vector<int> prev(m + 2, 0);
    std::vector<int> cur(m + 2, 0);
    prev[0] = 1;
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        cur[0] = prev[1];
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
            cur[j] = (prev[j - 1] + prev[j + 1]) % MODULO;
        }
        if (i % 2 == 1) {
            for (int j = 1; i + j <= m; j += 2)
                ans = (ans + cur[j]) % MODULO;
        }
        std::swap(prev, cur);
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
